# Chez Marielle

> Event planning and experiential marketing in New York City, by Marielle Folan, an event planner and experiential marketer. For brands, in-house event teams, clubs and communities, and anyone hosting at home.

Chez Marielle (Events & Experiences) plans and styles dinner parties, birthdays, brand events, member events, and other gatherings in New York City.

## What I do
- Event planning and production: planned and produced from start to finish, including the idea, the venue, the vendors, and the day itself.
- Experiential marketing support for in-house teams: extra support for in-house experiential marketing teams, on a contract or one-off basis.
- Consulting for clubs and community spaces: consulting for members' clubs and community-based spaces on the experiences they create for their members and guests.

## Private dinner parties
Private dinner parties in New York City, at home or another venue, planned and styled from start to finish. Every dinner includes the concept and format, a mood board and tablescape mock-up (made after the client signs), venue search if needed, vendors and partners, budget, and day-of setup. Add-ons: florals, printed menus and other printed pieces, and playlist design. Every dinner starts with a free 15-minute call and is quoted after it. Page: https://chezmarielle.com/private-dinners/

## Brand dinners and experiential marketing
Brand dinners, including influencer dinners and press dinners, and event production in New York City, planned and styled from start to finish, with a mood board and a mock-up of the table before the day. Every brand dinner includes the concept and format, a mood board and tablescape mock-up (made after the client signs), venue search if needed, vendors and partners, budget, and day-of setup. Marielle also gives in-house and agency experiential marketing teams extra support, on a contract or one-off basis, booked by the day or by the hour. Brand partners on her past events include Ehlers Estate, Juliet Wine, and Vinat (now Offline Wine). Every brand dinner is quoted after a free 15-minute call. Page: https://chezmarielle.com/brand-events/

## What I can help with
Florals; tablescapes; grazing spreads; printed menus, booklets, and signage; activity stations, like a bouquet bar or DIY wine charms; wine selection and tastings; venue and vendors; day-of setup.

## Past events
Photos and details: https://chezmarielle.com/past-events/

- The Blind Table (September 2026, Midtown, Manhattan, 21 guests, with Ehlers Estate): a blind tasting played like The Traitors: at each table, one guest knew every wine and steered the rest toward the wrong answers. Five Ehlers Estate wines and light bites, in a Midtown studio.
- Good Wine, Better Chemistry (February 2026, Maxwell Social, 24 guests, with Ehlers Estate): a Galentine's tasting of six experimental wines from Ehlers Estate's R&D label. Guests played a guided game to find their best match, with light bites and a DIY wine charm station, in the Garden Room at Maxwell Social.
- Feast of Saint Elsa (January 2026, Maxwell Social, 150 guests): Maxwell Social is named after Elsa Maxwell, the society hostess famous for over-the-top parties and costume balls, so for the club's twice-yearly members-only feast, we threw one in her honor. I planned the night and spent the day setting it up: I arranged all of the flowers and built the grazing spread and the champagne tower with help from the bar staff. Dinner's centerpiece was a whole roasted pig, served alongside a menu I coordinated with the club's in-house chef.
- Christmas Party (December 2025, Maxwell Social, 250 guests): for Maxwell's black-tie-optional Christmas party, I wanted to put together something special for the members. Alongside a live band and a visit from Santa, I worked with a bakery on a cookie-decorating station, so guests in gowns and tuxedos had a fun, hands-on moment with piping bags and sprinkles.
- Autumn Affairs (November 2025, Dacia Gallery, about 30 guests, with Juliet Wine): an autumn wine tasting with Juliet Wine at an art gallery. We styled the gallery for fall, and Juliet's founder poured her wines and explained them.
- Celebrating Ladies in Wine: European Summer Edition (March 2025, Style Shutter Studios, about 30 guests, with Vinat, now Offline Wine): a European summer wine tasting with Vinat: a greenery runner with lemons and mini disco balls, gold taper candles, and illustrated menus.

## About
Marielle Folan founded Ladies Wine Club NYC, a community for young professional women in New York with more than 200 members, and has planned and produced more than 20 of its events. She was also Head of Membership at Maxwell Social, a private members' club in New York City, where she planned and produced member events.
